ios.desc:
Instagram, made for your space.

Just for Instagram turns Instagram on the web into an app that feels at home in your space: a real native tab bar, instant tab switching, pull to refresh, and a distraction-free video player.

NATIVE WHERE IT COUNTS
• Native tab bar for Home, Explore, Reels, Messages and Profile
• Tabs stay loaded, so switching is instant and your scroll position is kept
• Background preloading means fewer loading screens
• Pull to refresh, progress indicator and clear error recovery

WATCH IN YOUR SPACE
• Open Reels and videos in a focused player
• A spatial layout with glass materials and hover effects
• Works with your existing Instagram account — no extra sign-up

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account data, analytics or usage data collected by the app
• No third-party trackers and no extra ads

Just for Instagram is an independent third-party client. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Instagram or Meta.
